Classes.Description: D3D12 rendering methods, usable only on the render thread. The module records and executes its own lists on the direct queue during RTDraw and may submit background work during RTAfterPresent. Members.Description: Creates a GPU timestamp counter bound to a direct-queue command list. Each scope must begin and end while recording and its list must execute in the same frame, before RTAfterPresent returns. Release each scope before closing its list. Use the SDK MGDF::D3D12CommandList helper for Close/Reset tracking; an untracked list returns E_INVALIDARG. A scope released after Close/Reset or the end of its frame is logged and discarded without recording a timestamp. Compute/copy lists are unsupported and return E_INVALIDARG.

Args.Description: The metric the counter updates
